findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 22 December 2025.

One director is linked to 11 other companies: 8 active, 2 dissolved and 1 in liquidation.
The accounts were last made up to 31 December 2023, and their overdue status is unknown because no next due date is recorded.
The confirmation statement was last made up to 5 March 2025, and its overdue status is unknown because no next due date is recorded.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, holding 75 to 100 percent ownership of shares.
No charges are registered against the company, and no registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations were filed since 24 October 2025.
